crossRefs.note: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around…
You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and…

translations.web: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.
translations.bsb: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
translations.asv: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
